title: Know Good
role: Designed, modeled, rigged, animated. 18 pieces of show content for summer/fall tour. Maintained brand and visual consistency across the full set.
brief: Know Good needed tour visuals - a lot of them. We determined that a spread of hero moments, branded longer format content, and easy execution shorter content was going to be the key to filling their live show experience with a new level of production. Story telling, consistency, juicy moments.
process: Brand alignment / visual language for the set
18-piece variation strategy (how to keep variety while staying consistent)
Rigging system that scaled across pieces
